OpenCharts chart library
Library Open studio
Every chart, editable HTML · CSS · JS

Pick a chart. Change it. Take the code.

Every chart here opens in a studio where the data, the colours and the options are live controls. What you see is generated from the same definition that produces the code below it — so the snippet you copy is the chart you built, not an approximation of it.

Five ways out. The studio emits the markup, the stylesheet and the script separately, plus a standalone page that inlines all three and runs the moment you open it — and an AI prompt you can hand to any assistant along with your own spreadsheet.

Charts run on Chart.js, D3, plain Canvas 2D or the dependency-free OpenCharts engine — the badge on each tile tells you which before you commit to it.

Have a table? Find the charts that can read it.

Paste it, or open a spreadsheet. Nothing is uploaded — the file is read in this browser and never sent anywhere.

Commas, tabs and semicolons all work.

Paste something on the left and the gallery below narrows to the charts that can draw it.

Built on other people's work

OpenCharts is free and open source. So is everything it stands on — here is the full list, with the exact versions this site is pinned to. The studio shows you which of these any individual chart needs before you copy it.
